Overview.Name: Rajeev Nayan
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal, avoids non-veg on Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday

Meal_1 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2–3 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (100 g) & vegetable curry
Meal_2 (Dinner - lighter): Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & egg omelette (2 eggs)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & paneer cubes (80 g) + vegetable curry

Notes_and_Tips: On Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday follow vegetarian options only.
Start meals with protein before eating rice to control portions.
For social gatherings, eat your regular meal first before outside food.
Keep dinner lighter to support fat loss.
Consistency in meal timing is important with shift work.
